description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Possessed Skaab
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Possessed Skaab
When Possessed Skaab enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cloudshift to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
